section: Ohio corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income (franchise) tax
value: None: Ohio phased out its corporation franchise tax in favor of the Commercial Activity Tax
note: Phased out over report years 2006-2010; the franchise tax now applies only to a small number of special corporations, and banks pay a separate Financial Institutions Tax.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Corporation Franchise Tax (publication)

section: Ohio corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) rate
note: Gross-receipts tax on Ohio taxable gross receipts above the annual exclusion; applies to all business forms, not just corporations.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) (September 3, 2025)

section: Ohio corporate income and franchise taxes
label: CAT annual exclusion
note: For tax years 2025 and later only receipts above $6 million are taxed and smaller businesses owe nothing ($3 million in 2024). The annual minimum tax ended in 2024.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT) (September 3, 2025)

label: Levied by
value: School districts, counties, municipalities, townships and special service districts
note: Taxable (assessed) value is 35% of market value; county auditors appraise property.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

label: State oversight
value: Ohio Department of Taxation, Division of Tax Equalization
note: Oversees county auditors' six-year reappraisals and three-year updates using sales-ratio studies.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

label: Limit on unvoted property tax (10-mill limitation)
value: Unvoted levies may not exceed 1% of true value (10 mills on taxable value, about 0.35% of market value)
note: Constitutional limit on 'inside' millage; voter-approved levies are on top.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

label: Homestead exemption (seniors, disabled and certain survivors)
note: Shields up to $29,000 of market value for qualifying owners (income limit $40,000 for tax year 2025); amount is indexed for inflation each year, so the 2026 figure may differ.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Property Tax - Real Property

label: Real property conveyance fee (state-mandated)
value: 1 mill ($1 per $1,000 of value transferred), in all 88 counties
note: Mandatory fee set by state law; revenue goes to the county general fund.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Real Property Conveyance Fees

label: Mandatory conveyance fee rate
note: Same fee expressed as a rate.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Real Property Conveyance Fees

label: County permissive transfer fee
value: Up to 3 additional mills ($3 per $1,000); every county levies 1 to 3 mills
note: Counties may set a lower rate for homestead-exemption property. Total can reach 4 mills.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Real Property Conveyance Fees

label: Who pays
note: Paid at the time of transfer.
source_title: Ohio Department of Taxation: Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report, Real Property Conveyance Fees
